title: Efficient Record-and-Replay Arithmetic for Quantum Elliptic-Curve Point Addition
summary: We study reversible secp256k1 point-addition circuits developed through ECDSA.Fail for Shor's elliptic-curve discrete-logarithm algorithm. Two complementary constructions improve record-and-replay GCD arithmetic: Jump-2 groups binary-GCD steps and compresses their decisions using base-5 encoding, while ping-pong uses fixed register alternation and one-bit decisions to avoid full-width comparisons and data-dependent swaps. Fused replay combines doubling and signed addition into one modular correction. Both constructions support quantum-addressed window selection with measurement-based lookup…
